items.instanceNote: ⚑ System contested between two Rev-4 (08/09/24) sheets: A120 hatches Dry Storage 008 open-to-structure at 12'-3 3/8" (legend: 'OPEN TO UNDERSIDE OF FLOOR / ROOF SYSTEM ABOVE - PAINT ALL ELEMENTS'); A510.2 tags 008 at 8'-0" and ID-1.6 shows PT-07 at 8'-0" - the reading the draft PT-07 line carries - and A513 view 2 draws a ceiling-fixture layout over 008. Whether 008 gets an 8'-0" lid or exposed painted structure is unresolved - check A120 vs A510.2 / A513 view 2 before pricing either scope.
